notablePrerequisites: All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Ethereal Forager as an attacker.
Ethereal Forager triggers, returning Time Warp from exile to your hand.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping it, returning Ethereal Forager to your hand from the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ethereal Forager by paying {3}{U}{U} and exiling Time Warp from your graveyard.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
